name: rosetta-sum-multiples-of-3-and-5
code:
use default

sum_of_multiples(below: long) -> long =>
    (1L..below)
        |> filter(n => n % 3L == 0L \/ n % 5L == 0L)
        |> reduce(0L, (running, n) => running + n)

for below in [10L, 1000L, 1000000L] do
    write_line("below {below,8}: {sum_of_multiples(below)}")
od
